title.en: Unit 6: Choosing a Career, Reading, and Bilal
title.ur: Chhatha Unit: Pesha chunna, Parhna aur Bilal

title.en: How do you choose your career?

intro.en: Allah created people different, so they serve each other through different jobs. The text explains how a young person can know himself and choose a suitable career. Then come exercises on the text and its words.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum seekhenge ke Allah ne logon ko mukhtalif banaya hai taake woh alag alag kaam karke ek doosre ki khidmat karein. Text batata hai ke naujawan apne aap ko pehchan kar munasib pesha kaise chune. Phir text aur alfaz ki mashqein hain.
intro.ar: خَلَقَ اللهُ النّاسَ مُخْتَلِفينَ فَتَنَوَّعَتْ مِهَنُهُمْ لِيَخْدِمَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا. يَشْرَحُ النَّصُّ كَيْفَ يَعْرِفُ الشّابُّ نَفْسَهُ وَيَخْتارُ المِهْنَةَ المُناسِبَةَ، ثُمَّ تَأْتي تَمارينُ عَلَى النَّصِّ وَمُفْرَداتِهِ.

dialogue.ar: تَخْتَلِفُ قُدُراتُ الأَفْرادِ وَرَغَباتُهُم، وَلِذلِكَ تَتَعَدَّدُ المِهَنُ في المُجْتَمَعِ.
dialogue.tr: takhtalifu qudurātu l-afrādi wa raghabātuhum, wa li-dhālika tataʿaddadu l-mihanu fil-mujtamaʿ
dialogue.en: People differ in their abilities and wishes, and so jobs are many in society.
dialogue.ur: Logon ki salahiyatein aur khwahishein alag hoti hain, isliye muashre mein pesha bahut se hote hain.

dialogue.ar: فَالمُزارِعُ يَخْدِمُ النّاسَ بِالزِّراعَةِ، وَالطَّبيبُ يَخْدِمُهُم بِعِلاجِهِم، وَكُلٌّ مِنْهُما يَحْتاجُ إِلى الآخَرِ.
dialogue.tr: fal-muzāriʿu yakhdimu n-nāsa biz-zirāʿah, waṭ-ṭabību yakhdimuhum bi-ʿilājihim, wa kullun minhumā yaḥtāju ilal-ākhar
dialogue.en: The farmer serves people through farming, the doctor serves them by treating them, and each needs the other.
dialogue.ur: Kisaan kheti se logon ki khidmat karta hai, doctor ilaaj se, aur dono ek doosre ke mohtaaj hain.

dialogue.ar: وَلَوْ تَرَكَ الجَميعُ الزِّراعَةَ لَجاعَ النّاسُ وَوَقَفَتْ حَياتُهُم.
dialogue.tr: wa law taraka l-jamīʿu z-zirāʿata la-jāʿa n-nāsu wa waqafat ḥayātuhum
dialogue.en: If everyone left farming, people would go hungry and their life would stand still.
dialogue.ur: Agar sab kheti chhor dete to log bhooke rehte aur unki zindagi ruk jati.

dialogue.ar: كانَ الأَبْناءُ قَديماً يَسيرونَ عَلى خُطا آبائِهِم دونَ أَنْ يَخْتاروا.
dialogue.tr: kāna l-abnāʾu qadīman yasīrūna ʿalā khuṭā ābāʾihim dūna an yakhtārū
dialogue.en: In the old days sons followed in their fathers’ footsteps without choosing.
dialogue.ur: Pehle bete bina chune apne walid ke naqsh-e-qadam par chalte the.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا اليَوْمَ فَعَلى الشّابِّ أَنْ يَسْأَلَ نَفْسَهُ: مَاذَا أُحِبُّ؟ وَمَاذَا أُحْسِنُ؟
dialogue.tr: ammā l-yawma fa-ʿalā sh-shābbi an yasʾala nafsah: mādhā uḥibb? wa mādhā uḥsin?
dialogue.en: Today a young man must ask himself: what do I love, and what am I good at?
dialogue.ur: Aaj naujawan ko apne aap se poochna chahiye: mujhe kya pasand hai? aur main kya acha karta hoon?

dialogue.ar: وَلا يَكْفي أَنْ يَنْظُرَ إِلى الرّاتِبِ أَوِ السَّفَرِ، بَلْ يَنْظُرُ إِلى مَيْلِهِ وَذَكائِهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa lā yakfī an yanẓura ilar-rātibi awis-safar, bal yanẓuru ilā maylihi wa dhakāʾihi wa qudratih
dialogue.en: It is not enough to look at salary or travel; he looks at his interest, intelligence and ability.
dialogue.ur: Sirf tankhwah ya safar dekhna kaafi nahi, balkeh apna rujhan, zehanat aur salahiyat dekhe.

dialogue.ar: وَيَسْتَفيدُ مِنْ مَشورَةِ أُسْرَتِهِ وَصَديقِهِ وَمِنْ مُساعَدَةِ أَهْلِ الخِبْرَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa yastafīdu min mashūrati usratihi wa ṣadīqihi wa min musāʿadati ahlil-khibrah
dialogue.en: He benefits from the advice of his family and friend and from the help of experienced people.
dialogue.ur: Woh apne ghar walon aur dost ke mashwaray aur tajurbe walon ki madad se faida uthaye.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ يَتَدَرَّبُ بِصَبْرٍ، فَمَنْ أَحَبَّ عَمَلَهُ أَتْقَنَهُ.
dialogue.tr: thumma yatadarrabu bi-ṣabr, fa-man aḥabba ʿamalahu atqanah
dialogue.en: Then he trains patiently, for whoever loves his work masters it.
dialogue.ur: Phir sabr se training le, kyunke jo apne kaam se mohabbat karta hai use khoob nibhata hai.

q.en: Why are there many different jobs in society, according to the text?
q.ur: Text ke mutabiq muashre mein mukhtalif pesha kyun hain?
q.ar: لِماذا تَتَعَدَّدُ المِهَنُ في المُجْتَمَعِ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

options: Because people differ in abilities and wishes
options_ar: لِأَنَّ النّاسَ يَخْتَلِفونَ في قُدُراتِهِمْ وَرَغَباتِهِمْ
لِأَنَّ أَحَداً لا يَحْتاجُ إِلى غَيْرِهِ

q.en: What would happen if everyone left farming?
q.ur: Agar sab kheti chhor dete to kya hota?
q.ar: ماذا يَحْدُثُ لَوْ تَرَكَ الجَميعُ الزِّراعَةَ؟

q.en: What does «مِهْنَة» mean?
q.ur: «مِهْنَة» ka matlab kya hai?

options_ar: عَمَلٌ يَقومُ بِهِ الإِنْسانُ لِيَكْسِبَ رِزْقَهُ

q.en: What should a young man ask himself first?
q.ur: Naujawan ko pehle apne aap se kya poochna chahiye?

options: What do I love and what am I good at?

q.en: Besides salary and travel, what should he look at?
q.ur: Tankhwah aur safar ke ilawa use kya dekhna chahiye?
q.ar: ماذا يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ الشّابُّ غَيْرَ الرّاتِبِ وَالسَّفَرِ؟

title.en: Grammar A: The noun ending in madd (hamza after alif)

intro.en: A mamdood noun is a noun that ends with alif followed by hamza, like الحَمْراء (red) or الدُّعاء (prayer). When we make it dual (two), the hamza may stay, turn into و, or turn into ي. It depends on where the hamza came from.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum seekhenge ism-e-mamdood: woh lafz jiske aakhir mein alif ke baad hamza ho, jaise الحَمْراء aur الدُّعاء. Jab hum iska tasniya (do) banate hain to hamza kabhi wahi rehta hai, kabhi و ban jata hai, kabhi ي. Yeh is par hai ke hamza kahan se aaya.
intro.ar: الاسْمُ المَمْدودُ اسْمٌ يَنْتَهي بِأَلِفٍ بَعْدَها هَمْزَةٌ، مِثْلُ «الحَمْراء» وَ«الدُّعاء». وَعِنْدَ تَثْنِيَتِهِ قَدْ تَبْقَى الهَمْزَةُ أَوْ تَنْقَلِبُ واوًا أَوْ ياءً بِحَسَبِ أَصْلِها.

vocab.ur: alif aur hamza par khatam hone wala ism

q.en: Which word is a mamdood noun?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz ism-e-mamdood hai?

q.en: What is the dual of «الدُّعاء» (prayer)?
q.ur: «الدُّعاء» ka tasniya kya hai?

q.en: What is the dual of «حَمْراء»?
q.ur: «حَمْراء» ka tasniya kya hai?

q.en: In the dual, what happens to the hamza of a feminine mamdood word like حَمْراء?
q.ur: Tasniya mein muannas mamdood lafz (jaise حَمْراء) ke hamza ka kya hota hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَحْدُثُ لِهَمْزَةِ الاسْمِ المَمْدودِ المُؤَنَّثِ مِثْلِ «حَمْراء» في المُثَنّى؟

q.en: What does «اللِّقاء» mean?
q.ur: «اللِّقاء» ka matlab kya hai?

title.ar: فَهْمُ المَسْموع: كَيْفَ يُحِبُّ أَطْفالُنا القِراءَة
title.en: Listening: How do our children come to love reading?
title.ur: Sunna aur samajhna: Hamare bachche parhna kaise pasand karein

intro.en: Two listening texts about getting children to love reading. After listening, you mark each sentence true or false. Here we read the sentences so you can practise the ideas.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum seekhenge ke bachchon mein parhne ki mohabbat kaise paida ho. Do sunne wale text hain; sunkar har jumle ko sahi ya ghalat batana hota hai. Yahan hum woh jumle parhte hain.
intro.ar: نَصّانِ مَسْموعانِ عَنْ كَيْفِيَّةِ تَحْبيبِ الأَطْفالِ في القِراءَةِ. بَعْدَ الاسْتِماعِ تُحَدِّدُ كُلَّ جُمْلَةٍ صَوابًا أَوْ خَطَأً، وَهُنا نَقْرَأُ الجُمَلَ لِنَتَدَرَّبَ عَلَى الأَفْكارِ.

dialogue.ar: يَقْضي المُراهِقونَ ساعاتٍ طَويلَةً أَمامَ الحاسوبِ وَالشَّبَكَةِ الدَّوْلِيَّةِ وَيَبْتَعِدونَ عَنِ الكُتُبِ.
dialogue.tr: yaqḍī l-murāhiqūna sāʿātin ṭawīlatan amāmal-ḥāsūbi wash-shabakati d-dawliyyati wa yabtaʿidūna ʿanil-kutub
dialogue.en: Teenagers spend long hours in front of the computer and the internet and keep away from books.
dialogue.ur: Nojawan ghanton computer aur internet ke saamne guzarte hain aur kitabon se door ho jate hain.

dialogue.ar: أَفْضَلُ طَريقَةٍ لِتَحْبيبِ الأَبْناءِ في القِراءَةِ أَنْ يَرَوْا والِدَيْهِمْ يَقْرَؤونَ.
dialogue.tr: afḍalu ṭarīqatin li-taḥbībil-abnāʾi fil-qirāʾati an yarawā wālidayhim yaqraʾūn
dialogue.en: The best way to make children love reading is for them to see their parents reading.
dialogue.ur: Bachchon ko parhne ka shauq dilane ka behtareen tareeqa yeh hai ke woh apne walidain ko parhte dekhein.

dialogue.ar: تَحْكي الأُمُّ لِطِفْلِها قِصَّةً جَميلَةً قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ، فَيَشْتاقُ إِلى الكِتابِ.
dialogue.tr: taḥkī l-ummu li-ṭiflihā qiṣṣatan jamīlatan qablan-nawm, fa-yashtāqu ilal-kitāb
dialogue.en: The mother tells her child a lovely story before sleep, so he longs for the book.
dialogue.ur: Maa apne bachche ko sone se pehle khoobsurat kahani sunati hai, to usay kitab ka shauq hota hai.

dialogue.ar: زِيارَةُ المَكْتَبَةِ مَعَ الأُسْرَةِ تَجْعَلُ القِراءَةَ مُتْعَةً لا واجِباً ثَقيلاً.
dialogue.tr: ziyāratul-maktabati maʿal-usrati tajʿalul-qirāʾata mutʿatan lā wājiban thaqīlā
dialogue.en: Visiting the library with the family makes reading a pleasure, not a heavy duty.
dialogue.ur: Khandan ke saath library jana parhne ko bojh nahi balkeh lutf bana deta hai.

dialogue.ar: يَنْمو خَيالُ الطِّفْلِ كُلَّما قَرَأَ أَكْثَرَ.
dialogue.tr: yanmū khayālu ṭ-ṭifli kullamā qaraʾa akthar
dialogue.en: A child’s imagination grows the more he reads.
dialogue.ur: Bachche ka khayal utna barhta hai jitna woh zyada parhta hai.

dialogue.ar: يُنْصَحُ الوالِدانِ بِأَنْ يَتْرُكا لِلطِّفْلِ حُرِّيَّةَ اخْتِيارِ كِتابِهِ.
dialogue.tr: yunṣaḥul-wālidāni bi-an yatrukā liṭ-ṭifli ḥurriyyata khtiyāri kitābih
dialogue.en: Parents are advised to leave the child free to choose his book.
dialogue.ur: Walidain ko mashwara hai ke bachche ko apni kitab chunne ki azadi dein.

dialogue.ar: تَنْصَحُ المُعَلِّمَةُ الأُمَّهاتِ بِأَلّا يُجْبِرْنَ أَطْفالَهُنَّ عَلى القِراءَةِ بِالعِقابِ.
dialogue.tr: tanṣaḥul-muʿallimatul-ummahāti bi-allā yujbirna aṭfālahunna ʿalal-qirāʾati bil-ʿiqāb
dialogue.en: The teacher advises mothers not to force their children to read by punishment.
dialogue.ur: Ustaani maaon ko mashwara deti hai ke bachchon ko saza se parhne par majboor na karein.

q.en: What does «القِراءَة» mean?
q.ur: «القِراءَة» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: What is the best way to make children love reading, according to the text?
q.ur: Text ke mutabiq bachchon ko parhne ka shauq dilane ka behtareen tareeqa kya hai?
q.ar: ما أَفْضَلُ طَريقَةٍ لِتَحْبيبِ الأَبْناءِ في القِراءَةِ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

options: That they see their parents reading

q.en: What makes reading a pleasure for the family?
q.ur: Kaunsi baat parhne ko khandan ke liye lutf banati hai?
q.ar: ما الَّذي يَجْعَلُ القِراءَةَ مُتْعَةً لِلأُسْرَةِ؟

q.en: What happens to a child’s imagination the more he reads?
q.ur: Bachche ka khayal zyada parhne se kya hota hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَحْدُثُ لِخَيالِ الطِّفْلِ كُلَّما قَرَأَ أَكْثَرَ؟

q.en: What does the teacher advise mothers not to do?
q.ur: Ustaani maaon ko kis baat se mana karti hai?

options: Force children to read by punishment

intro.en: In this lesson you practise talking with a classmate. You choose between two things, say your opinion and give reasons. Try it out loud with the four topics.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum apne sathi se guftagu ki mashq karenge. Do cheezon mein se ek chun kar apni raye aur wajah batate hain. Chaaron mauzuat par zubani koshish karein.
intro.ar: في هَذا الدَّرْسِ تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلَى الحِوارِ مَعَ زَميلٍ: تَخْتارُ بَيْنَ أَمْرَيْنِ وَتَذْكُرُ رَأْيَكَ وَأَسْبابَهُ. جَرِّبْ ذَلِكَ بِصَوْتٍ عالٍ في المَوْضوعاتِ الأَرْبَعَةِ.

dialogue.ar: السُّكْنى في المَدينَةِ أَوِ السُّكْنى في القَرْيَةِ.
dialogue.tr: as-suknā fil-madīnati awis-suknā fil-qaryah
dialogue.en: Living in the city or living in the village.
dialogue.ur: Shehar mein rehna ya gaon mein rehna.

dialogue.ar: تَناوُلُ الغَداءِ في المَطْعَمِ أَوْ في البَيْتِ مَعَ الأُسْرَةِ.
dialogue.tr: tanāwulul-ghadāʾi fil-maṭʿami aw fil-bayti maʿal-usrah
dialogue.en: Having lunch in a restaurant or at home with the family.
dialogue.ur: Dopahar ka khana restaurant mein ya ghar par khandan ke saath.

dialogue.ar: السَّفَرُ في العُطْلَةِ الصَّيْفِيَّةِ داخِلَ الوَطَنِ أَوْ إِلى بَلَدٍ آخَرَ.
dialogue.tr: as-safaru fil-ʿuṭlati ṣ-ṣayfiyyati dākhilal-waṭani aw ilā baladin ākhar
dialogue.en: Travelling in the summer holiday inside the homeland or to another country.
dialogue.ur: Garmiyon ki chhuttiyon mein watan ke andar ya kisi aur mulk safar karna.

dialogue.ar: أَيُّهُما أَهَمُّ لِبِناءِ الأُمَمِ: القَلَمُ أَمِ السَّيْفُ؟
dialogue.tr: ayyuhumā ahammu li-bināʾil-umam: al-qalamu amis-sayf
dialogue.en: Which is more important for building nations: the pen or the sword?
dialogue.ur: Qaumon ko banane ke liye kaun zyada ahem hai: qalam ya talwar?

q.en: What does «القَلَم» mean?
q.ur: «القَلَم» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: What does «الوَطَن» mean?
q.ur: «الوَطَن» ka matlab kya hai?

options_ar: البَلَدُ الَّذي يَعيشُ فيهِ الإِنْسانُ وَيَنْتَمي إِلَيْهِ

q.en: Which question asks about importance?
q.ur: Kaun sa sawal ahmiyat ke bare mein hai?

q.en: What does «العُطْلَة الصَّيْفِيَّة» mean?
q.ur: «العُطْلَة الصَّيْفِيَّة» ka matlab kya hai?

options_ar: راحَةٌ مِنَ الدِّراسَةِ في فَصْلِ الصَّيْفِ

title.ar: القَواعِد (ب): جَزْمُ المُضارِعِ في جَوابِ الطَّلَب
title.en: Grammar B: The jussive verb after a request
title.ur: Qawaid (be): Talab ke jawab mein mudari majzoom

intro.en: When a command or a «لا» prohibition is followed by a present-tense verb that is the result of it, that verb takes jazm (sukoon). Example: «أَسْلِمْ تَسْلَمْ» means 'Accept Islam, you will be safe.' The first part is the request, the second is its result.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum seekhenge ke jab hukm ya «لا» se mana karne ke baad aisa mudari fel aaye jo uska nateeja ho, to us par jazm (sukoon) aata hai. Misaal: «أَسْلِمْ تَسْلَمْ» yani 'Islam laao, salamat raho.' Pehla hissa talab hai, doosra uska nateeja.
intro.ar: إِذا جاءَ فِعْلٌ مُضارِعٌ بَعْدَ أَمْرٍ أَوْ نَهْيٍ بِـ«لا» وَكانَ جَوابًا لَهُ جُزِمَ بِالسُّكونِ. مِثالُ ذَلِكَ «أَسْلِمْ تَسْلَمْ»: الأَوَّلُ طَلَبٌ وَالثّاني جَوابُهُ.

dialogue.ar: أَسْلِمْ تَسْلَمْ.
dialogue.tr: aslim taslam
dialogue.en: Submit, you will be safe.
dialogue.ur: Islam laao, salamat raho.

dialogue.ar: ذاكِرْ دَرْسَكَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ تَنْجَحْ في الامْتِحانِ.
dialogue.tr: dhākir darsaka kulla yawmin tanjaḥ fil-imtiḥān
dialogue.en: Study your lesson every day, you will succeed in the exam.
dialogue.ur: Roz apna sabaq yaad karo, imtihan mein kaamyab ho jaoge.

dialogue.ar: اِبْتَسِمْ لِلنّاسِ يَبْتَسِموا لَكَ.
dialogue.tr: ibtasim lin-nāsi yabtasimū lak
dialogue.en: Smile at people, they will smile at you.
dialogue.ur: Logon ko dekh kar muskurao, woh bhi tumhein dekh kar muskurayenge.

dialogue.ar: لا تُؤْذِ جارَكَ تَعِشْ في سَلامٍ.
dialogue.tr: lā tuʾdhi jāraka taʿish fī salām
dialogue.en: Do not harm your neighbour, you will live in peace.
dialogue.ur: Padosi ko takleef na do, sukoon se rahoge.

dialogue.ar: لا تُجادِلِ السُّفَهاءَ تَسْلَمْ مِنْ أَذاهُم.
dialogue.tr: lā tujādilis-sufahāʾa taslam min adhāhum
dialogue.en: Do not argue with the foolish, you will be safe from their harm.
dialogue.ur: Bewaqoofon se behes na karo, unki takleef se mehfooz rahoge.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تَزورُ الجارَ تَكْسَبْ مَحَبَّتَهُ؟
dialogue.tr: hal tazūrul-jāra taksab maḥabbatah
dialogue.en: Will you visit the neighbour and gain his love?
dialogue.ur: Kya tum padosi se milne jaoge, uski mohabbat paoge?

dialogue.ar: أَفْشِ السَّلامَ بَيْنَ النّاسِ تَكْسِبْ مَحَبَّتَهُم.
dialogue.tr: afshis-salāma baynan-nāsi taksib maḥabbatahum
dialogue.en: Spread peace among people, you will win their love.
dialogue.ur: Logon mein salam phailao, unki mohabbat kamao.

dialogue.ar: وَأَحْسِنْ إِلى جارِكَ تَكُنْ مُؤْمِناً.
dialogue.tr: wa aḥsin ilā jārika takun muʾminan
dialogue.en: Be good to your neighbour, you will be a believer.
dialogue.ur: Apne padosi se bhalai karo, mumin banoge.

title.ar: القِراءَةُ المُوَسَّعَة: بِلالُ بْنُ رَباحٍ مُؤَذِّنُ رَسولِ اللهِ
title.en: Reading: Bilal ibn Rabah, the muadhdhin of the Messenger of Allah
title.ur: Parhna: Bilal bin Rabah, Rasoolullah ﷺ ke muazzin

intro.en: A reading text about the life of Bilal ibn Rabah (may Allah be pleased with him): his birth, his Islam, his patience under torture, his freedom, the first adhan in Madinah and his last days. After it come questions and word exercises.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum Bilal bin Rabah (Allah un se razi ho) ki zindagi parhenge: unki paidaish, Islam, azeeyaton par sabr, aazadi, Madina mein pehli azaan aur aakhri din. Is ke baad sawalat aur alfaz ki mashqein hain.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ عَنْ حَياةِ بِلالِ بْنِ رَباحٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ: وِلادَتِهِ وَإِسْلامِهِ وَصَبْرِهِ عَلَى التَّعْذيبِ وَعِتْقِهِ وَأَوَّلِ أَذانٍ في المَدينَةِ وَأَيّامِهِ الأَخيرَةِ. وَبَعْدَهُ أَسْئِلَةٌ وَتَمارينُ عَلَى الكَلِماتِ.

dialogue.ar: هُوَ بِلالُ بْنُ رَباحٍ، نَشَأَ في مَكَّةَ وَعاشَ عَبْداً عِنْدَ أُمَيَّةَ بْنِ خَلَفٍ.
dialogue.tr: huwa bilālu bnu rabāḥ, nashaʾa fī makkata wa ʿāsha ʿabdan ʿinda umayyata bni khalaf
dialogue.en: He is Bilal ibn Rabah, who grew up in Makkah and lived as a slave of Umayyah ibn Khalaf.
dialogue.ur: Yeh Bilal bin Rabah hain, Makkah mein pale barhe aur Umayyah bin Khalaf ke ghulam rahe.

dialogue.ar: أَسْلَمَ في بِدايَةِ الدَّعْوَةِ، فَغَضِبَ سَيِّدُهُ وَقَرَّرَ أَنْ يُعَذِّبَهُ.
dialogue.tr: aslama fī bidāyatid-daʿwah, fa-ghaḍiba sayyiduhu wa qarrara an yuʿadhdhibah
dialogue.en: He accepted Islam at the start of the call, so his master grew angry and decided to torture him.
dialogue.ur: Woh dawat ke shuru mein musalman hue, to unka malik naraz hua aur unhein azaab dene ka faisla kiya.

dialogue.ar: كانُوا يُخْرِجونَهُ إِلى الرَّمْضاءِ إِذا اشْتَدَّتْ حَرارَتُها وَيَضْرِبونَهُ بِالسِّياطِ.
dialogue.tr: kānū yukhrijūnahu ilar-ramḍāʾi idhā shtaddat ḥarāratuhā wa yaḍribūnahu bis-siyāṭ
dialogue.en: They would take him out to the scorching sand when its heat grew fierce and whip him.
dialogue.ur: Woh unhein jab garmi sakht hoti to tapti ret par le jate aur koron se marte.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ يَضَعونَ عَلى صَدْرِهِ صَخْرَةً ثَقيلَةً لِيَتْرُكَ دينَهُ.
dialogue.tr: thumma yaḍaʿūna ʿalā ṣadrihi ṣakhratan thaqīlatan li-yatruka dīnah
dialogue.en: Then they put a heavy rock on his chest so he would leave his religion.
dialogue.ur: Phir unke seene par bhaari patthar rakhte taake woh apna deen chhor dein.

dialogue.ar: فَلَمْ يَزِدْ عَلى قَوْلِهِ: أَحَدٌ، أَحَدٌ، وَصَبَرَ صَبْرَ الأَبْطالِ مَعَ المُسْتَضْعَفينَ.
dialogue.tr: fa-lam yazid ʿalā qawlihi: aḥad, aḥad, wa ṣabara ṣabral-abṭāli maʿal-mustaḍʿafīn
dialogue.en: He said nothing more than: One, One, and was patient like heroes, with the other weak believers.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne bas yahi kaha: Ahad, Ahad, aur kamzor musalmanon ke saath bahadron ki tarah sabr kiya.

dialogue.ar: مَرَّ بِهِ الصِّدّيقُ أَبو بَكْرٍ، رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، فَحَزِنَ لِحالِهِ وَدَفَعَ الثَّمَنَ ذَهَباً، وَاشْتَراهُ وَأَعْتَقَهُ.
dialogue.tr: marra bihi abū bakrin iṣ-ṣiddīqu raḍiya llāhu ʿanh fa-ḥazina li-ḥālihi wa dafaʿa th-thamana dhahaban wa shtarāhu wa aʿtaqah
dialogue.en: Abu Bakr as-Siddiq, may Allah be pleased with him, passed by him, felt sad for his state, paid the price in gold, bought him and freed him.
dialogue.ur: Abu Bakr Siddiq (raziyallahu anhu) wahan se guzre, unki haalat par ghamgeen hue, sone ki qeemat de kar unhein khareeda aur azaad kar diya.

dialogue.ar: هاجَرَ بِلالٌ إِلى المَدينَةِ المُنَوَّرَةِ وَشارَكَ في الجِهادِ مَعَ الرَّسولِ ﷺ.
dialogue.tr: hājara bilālun ilal-madīnatil-munawwarah wa shāraka fil-jihādi maʿar-rasūl
dialogue.en: Bilal migrated to Madinah and took part in jihad with the Messenger ﷺ.
dialogue.ur: Bilal Madinah Munawwarah hijrat kar gaye aur Rasoolullah ﷺ ke saath jihad mein shareek hue.

dialogue.ar: وَعِنْدَما شُرِعَ الأَذانُ اخْتارَهُ الرَّسولُ ﷺ لِحُسْنِ صَوْتِهِ، فَصارَ أَوَّلَ مُؤَذِّنٍ في الإِسْلامِ.
dialogue.tr: wa ʿindamā shuriʿal-adhānu khtārahur-rasūlu li-ḥusni ṣawtih, fa-ṣāra awwala muʾadhdhinin fil-islām
dialogue.en: When the adhan was prescribed, the Messenger ﷺ chose him for his beautiful voice, and he became the first muadhdhin in Islam.
dialogue.ur: Jab azaan mashroo hui to Rasoolullah ﷺ ne unhein unki khoobsurat awaz ki wajah se chuna aur woh Islam ke pehle muazzin bane.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ وَفاةِ الرَّسولِ ﷺ اشْتَدَّ حُزْنُهُ فَأَمْسَكَ عَنِ الأَذانِ وَسافَرَ إِلى الشّامِ.
dialogue.tr: wa baʿda wafātir-rasūl ishtadda ḥuznuhu fa-amsaka ʿanil-adhāni wa sāfara ilash-shām
dialogue.en: After the Messenger’s death his sadness grew strong, so he stopped giving the adhan and travelled to Ash-Sham.
dialogue.ur: Rasoolullah ﷺ ki wafat ke baad unka gham bahut barh gaya, to unhon ne azaan dena chhor diya aur Sham chale gaye.

dialogue.ar: وَسَكَنَ دِمَشْقَ، وَلَمّا زارَها عُمَرُ طَلَبَ مِنْهُ الصَّحابَةُ أَنْ يُؤَذِّنَ، فَبَكَى النّاسُ وَسالَتِ الدُّموعُ.
dialogue.tr: wa sakana dimashq, wa lammā zārahā ʿumaru ṭalaba minhuṣ-ṣaḥābatu an yuʾadhdhin, fa-bakan-nāsu wa sālatid-dumūʿ
dialogue.en: He settled in Damascus, and when Umar visited, the companions asked him to call the adhan, and people wept and tears flowed.
dialogue.ur: Woh Damishq mein rahe, jab Umar wahan aaye to sahaba ne unse azaan ki darkhwast ki, log royay aur aansu behne lage.

dialogue.ar: وَوافاهُ الأَجَلُ المَحْتومُ في دِمَشْقَ، فَلَفَظَ أَنْفاسَهُ الأَخيرَةَ راضِياً بِقَضاءِ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa wāfāhul-ajalul-maḥtūmu fī dimashq, fa-lafaẓa anfāsahul-akhīrata rāḍiyan bi-qaḍāʾi llāh
dialogue.en: His appointed end came in Damascus, and he breathed his last, content with Allah’s decree.
dialogue.ur: Damishq mein unka muqarrar waqt aa pahuncha, unhon ne aakhri saansein leen aur Allah ke faisle par razi the.

vocab.ur: unki wafat ka waqt aa gaya

vocab.en: he held back from the adhan
vocab.ur: woh azaan dene se ruk gaye
